equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Hamming distance at least three is sufficient but not necessary for disjoint one-downward-error balls: words with one disjoint one in each direction have Hamming distance two but their lower error shadows intersect; words with two bits only on one side and zero on the other have Hamming distance two and disjoint shadows if one-sided difference is two. The precise graph criteria and computed six-versus-eight capacities differ, ruling out direct rephrasing.

value.rationale: Combines the standard Fibonacci constrained source and one-direction asymmetric channel in a natural finite zero-error coding invariant. First n at which even integer-valued fractional packing LP fails to attain the integer zero-error capacity; in addition all 10 maximizers share a six-word core. This is a motivated sharp finite benchmark rather than merely a routine unrestricted code re-evaluation; no unproved all-length claims.
